items.title: Is Uber Stock Cheap, Or Is The Cash Already Spent?
items.summary: Uber Technologies (UBER) generates free cash flow worth 6.8% of its market value a year, against 4.5% for the median S&P 500 company. A gap that wide usually points to a business the market expects to shrink. Uber is not shrinking; revenue grew 16.7% over the trailing twelve months. So the question is who gets the cash.
